text:
samir: quick follow-up from the postmortem — saw a recurrent pattern: cert roll + short BGP withdraws -> regional LB retry spike and SNI mismatch errors for ~6-10m.
elaine: can we capture owners, short ETAs, and a one-line detection rule? ops needs this for the incident timeline.
sre_owen: i'll own the rotator hardening. plan: add a preflight route-convergence check and make the commit atomic (prepare/commit). also add a propagation TTL metric. ETA: 8d. JIRA: NET-3060.
kevin: i'll take LB mitigations: temporary cap on retries (2) + increase backoff multiplier during rotator windows under a feature flag. will land PR by Wed. JIRA: NET-3061.
elaine: i'll add post-rotate synthetic probes and a CI gate that checks SNI and cert subject per region. ETA: 3d. JIRA: NET-3062.
ops_rachel: i'll draft tenant comms and the runbook snippet for oncall (how to flip the flag + rollback steps). ETA: 48h. OPS-1350.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator canary scheduled v7.0.2 -> v7.0.3 on 2026-01-18T02:15Z (dry-run 30m prior).
sre_owen: detection draft (PromQL):
```
(sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[10m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[10m]))) > 0.035
```
-> alert to #incidents and page on-call if sustained 10m.
kevin: short-term tweak: will expose feature flag toggle and a maintenance-mode handler so ops can enable conservative backoff for the duration of the rotator. config will default to off.
elaine: validation snippet i'll add to CI:
```
curl -sSI https://us-lb.internal/health -H "Host: app.prod" --resolve app.prod:443:10.9.8.7 | grep -i "subject:\|sni"
```
will run post-canary and fail pipeline on mismatch.
ops_rachel: action table (copy-paste for the incident doc):
- owner:sre_owen, jira:NET-3060, task: atomic rotator + route-convergence preflight, eta: 8d
- owner:kevin, jira:NET-3061, task: LB retry cap + maintenance flag, eta: Wed EOD
- owner:elaine, jira:NET-3062, task: post-rotate synthetics + CI gate, eta: 3d
- owner:ops_rachel, jira:OPS-1350, task: tenant comms + runbook snippet, eta: 48h

samir: scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review acceptance criteria. using this thread as the canonical action tracker; please paste PR links and note timeline slips here. :white_check_mark:
